prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet, as all 7 tests resulted in no clear effect.
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests (+0.3% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screen, adoption redesign, finish new flow, and sign-in hint changes, as each has only 1 test so far.
Predictions were generally too high across tests, particularly for redesigns (predicted +12.0%, measured -3.4%) and new flows (predicted +2.0%, measured -4.6%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.3% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Persistence Warning Hint: Add an explicit hint explaining that signing in saves pet traits across app launches. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation Tip Carousel: Add an engaging tip carousel to the waiting screen explaining pet interactions during generation. (why: Waiting stage takes median 201s and mean 2336s; useful tips lower perceived waiting time and drop-offs.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Path Choice Clear Expectation Headline: Rephrase choose_path headline and body text to reassure users that path choices can be customized anytime. (why: High mean time (514s) indicates hesitation from users assuming path choices are permanent.)
3: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Badge: Add a playful mascot illustration and achievement badge to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption step drops from 72.9% to 60.9%; celebratory elements reward user commitment.)
4: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Troubleshooting Notification: Display a delayed notification offer for sign-in help if the screen stays idle for over 15 seconds. (why: Support logged bug reports about sign-in screen stalling or failing to load.)
5: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Progress Stage Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen layout to 'stage' mode featuring a visual progress tracker. (why: Waiting screen has high drop-off and high duration (mean 2336s); stage layout keeps progress transparent.)

scores.note: Support emails report data loss confusion; simple text hint has high cost efficiency.
Carousel targets long waiting screen duration (mean 2336s) to reduce idle drop-offs.
Addresses high hesitation time (514s) at initial path selection via text rephrasing.
Targets adoption drop (72.9% to 60.9%) with visual celebratory incentive.
Directly supported by support bug logs regarding stalling on sign-in screen.
Redesigns have shown negative measured lift (-3.4% average) and carry high implementation cost.
